description: Inventario Promedio de Combustibles is a dataset listed in Uruguayan national open data catalogue (catalogodatos.gub.uy), an open data portal, published or maintained by ANCAP. Muestra el inventario promedio mensual de crudo y productos, en m3. Se construye a partir del inventario diario de combustibles, por lo cual en los productos no incluye aditivos ni mejoradores y no incluye tanques cuyo contenido principal es agua ni producto en tanques fuera de servicio. Coverage: Uruguay. The portal files it under the publisher ANCAP. Its tags are ANCAP, Combustibles, Crudos, Inventario Promedio, Productos. It offers 4 resource(s) in CSV, JSON, XML. The portal shows 2026-09-09 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licencia de DAG de Uruguay. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support fuel supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-uy-portal.
